# HigherOrder_Spectral_Features

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
Features derived from the spectrum of higher-order tensors or hypergraphs, capturing multi-node correlations beyond pairwise interactions. Enables TCC to model complex network topologies and iNEST to process multi-modal sensory signals with richer representational capacity.
